span.p:
During partition:
- App writes accepted ← Cache is Available
- Dirty buffer grows (cannot flush)
- Reads return dirty data ← Inconsistent with DB
- When partition heals, flush resumes → Eventual Consistency

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Properties:
- Available: Yes (writes accepted during partition)
- Partition tolerant: Yes (buffer absorbs the partition)
- Consistent: Eventually (after flush catches up)
